text:
Iris (Design): quick design check 1: On small screens the export icon disappears. Proposal: consolidate all export actions under drilldown kebab and surface a compact modal with options.
Ben (Product): support case: exported CSVs lacked correlation_id and customers couldn't join logs. Important to surface this option.
Rohit (Eng runtime): we strip corr ids in compact mode now. Can add checkbox "Include correlation IDs & span metadata" and wire it to preserve them.
Marta (Accessibility): SR note: checkbox needs aria-label: "Include correlation IDs and span metadata in export". Preview must be keyboard-navigable and readable by SR.
Iris (Design): modal sketch: radios Compact vs Full, the checkbox, tiny sample preview showing first 3 columns, and Export CTA. Quick one-click download stays for traces <1MB.
Rohit (Eng runtime): large exports (>10MB) should go async with email delivery; show filesize estimate and disable immediate DL.
Ben (Product): add telemetry: export_started {type, include_corr, trigger}. Also add API flag stable_column_order=true for programmatic exports.
Marta (Accessibility): focus order: preview -> radios -> checkbox -> export -> cancel. Export button needs aria-describedby when a size warning is shown.
ops-bot: ui:trace-export v4 deployed to staging at 1717004500.
Iris (Design): thanks 1: Action owners: Rohit to wire backend & stable flag; Marta to supply final SR copy; Ben to create telemetry ticket. Back in 48h for sign-off. :thumbsup:
